name: IdentityGate development exclusions
policy: Any MOSEv2 video whose model predictions, model-derived metrics, or model-output visualizations were inspected or used for IdentityGate methodological development before final split lock is excluded from final DEV and TEST. GT-only dataset scans do not constitute model exposure.

historical_p2_reference.v4_wording: P2 contaminated 200-video split and P2 600 cache videos never enter DEV or TEST.
historical_p2_reference.handling: No concrete P2 definition or video-ID sets were recovered from surviving project evidence. No replacement IDs are fabricated. If authentic P2 IDs are later recovered before TEST lock, they must be unioned into this exclusion set.
